Who We Are

On Location is a global leader in premium experiential hospitality, offering ticketing, curated guest experiences, live event production and travel management across sports, entertainment, fashion and culture. On Location provides unrivaled access for corporate clients and fans looking for official, immersive experiences at marquee events, including the Olympic and Paralympic Games, FIFA World Cup 2026, Super Bowl, NCAA Final Four, and more. An official partner and/or service provider to over 150 iconic rights holders, such as the IOC (the Milano Cortina 2026 and Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games), FIFA, NFL, NCAA, UFC, WWE, and PGA of America, the company also owns and operates a number of its own unique experiences. On Location is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Role And What You’ll Do

The Head of Product leads the enterprise strategy, governance, and performance optimization of On Location’s global hospitality product portfolio across priority events and rightsholders.

This role positions Product as a core driver of margin-aware strategy and planning, responsible for ensuring product architecture supports commercial performance, operational feasibility, and scalable execution across the business. The SVP establishes structured frameworks to evaluate product investments, strengthen portfolio visibility, and embed analytics into decision-making across the product lifecycle.

Working in close partnership with General Managers and functional leaders across Commercial Strategy, Delivery / Production, Finance, Procurement, and Marketing, this leader ensures product decisions directly support P&L performance, pricing discipline, and enterprise growth priorities.

The Head of Product also leads product innovation and R&D initiatives to evolve On Location’s hospitality offerings and maintain competitive differentiation across global events.

Establish structured portfolio governance frameworks to evaluate product investments based on:
Margin contribution
Scalability
Delivery feasibility
Customer demand
Strategic alignment

Margin Visibility & Portfolio Performance Management

Data & Analytics Integration

Develop analytics capabilities supporting:
Product performance dashboards
Investment prioritization
Scenario modeling
Portfolio mix optimization

Support General Managers with structured insight to inform product strategy trade-offs and investment decisions.

Operationally feasible
Financially viable
Scalable across venues and programs

Establish structured concept validation processes prior to launch commitments.
Reduce downstream redesign risk through integrated planning discipline.

Product Innovation & R&D
Lead enterprise hospitality innovation strategy across experience formats, packaging structures, and service models.
Establish a structured R&D capability to pilot and evaluate new product concepts prior to scaling.
Monitor global premium hospitality and experiential trends to inform future product direction.
Strengthen differentiation and competitiveness while protecting margin performance.

Commercial Performance Enablement
Partner with Commercial Strategy, Revenue Growth Management, and Sales leadership to ensure product architecture supports revenue quality and pricing discipline.
Align packaging logic with enterprise pricing strategy and yield optimization frameworks.

Premium hospitality tiers
Enterprise client programs
Custom experiences

Delivery

Who We Are

Mediacom Communications Corporation is the 5th largest cable operator in the United States and the leading gigabit broadband provider to smaller markets primarily in the Midwest and Southeast. With a team of over 3,900 dedicated professionals, we are committed to bridging the digital divide between America's major cities and its smaller regions. Through its fiber-rich network, Mediacom offers high-speed data, video, phone, and mobile services to over 3 million households and businesses across 22 states. The company delivers scalable broadband solutions to commercial and public-sector customers of all sizes through Mediacom Business and sells advertising and production services under the OnMedia brand.

At Mediacom, we are passionate about growth and innovation. We offer faster, more reliable internet service, expanded digital and HD TV choices, and advanced home security and phone solutions. As we continue to expand, we strive to remain at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge entertainment, communications, and internet products. This year, we proudly launched our new mobile phone network, further enhancing our commitment to providing innovative and comprehensive services.

To achieve this, Mediacom Communications seeks talented professionals to partner with us to meet these challenges and realize what we can imagine. Take the next step toward a dynamic and rewarding career with Mediacom Communications. Learn more about us at mediacomcable.com

Position Overview

The Vice President of Device Product Management & Operations will lead Mediacom’s mobile device ecosystem strategy, supply chain operations, OEM partnerships, product lifecycle execution, and operational readiness initiatives. This leader will oversee the full portfolio of smartphones, tablets, wearables, accessories, BYOD programs, and value-added services while ensuring strong operational execution, inventory optimization, customer experience excellence, and long-term profitability.

Reporting to the Group Vice President, Mobile, this executive will work closely with product management, finance, marketing, customer care, sales, technology, logistics, and strategic vendor partners to ensure successful device launches, operational scalability, and continuous process improvement.

The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in wireless device operations, OEM negotiations, supply chain management, inventory forecasting, product lifecycle management, and cross-functional leadership.

At Mediacom, we believe that your success is our success, providing you the Power to Succeed in your career. Strong understanding of supply chain operations, demand forecasting, fulfillment, logistics, reverse logistics, and inventory planning.

jobs.description:
Mirage is an AI video company focused on making creation dramatically easier. Our team tackles some of the hardest creative and technical challenges in generative media.

We get to rethink how people collaborate with AI that can actually do creative work with them—defining entirely new interaction paradigms for AI-native video tools. We make that possible by building multimodal agents that turn creative direction into edits, rendering engines that composite multiple layers of video and graphics, and generative video models trained from the ground up that create new media when needed.

All of this comes together in Captions, our creative workspace for generating, editing, and designing video. The technology behind Captions is now available more broadly: Tesseract gives any AI agent native video-editing capabilities, while developers can integrate our models into their own products through APIs.

Explore our work

Captions — Our flagship creative workspace

Tesseract — Our professional video engine for AI agents

Research — The foundation models we build in-house

Updates — The latest from Mirage

TechCrunch, Forbes, Fast Company — Press

Our Investors

We’re very fortunate to have some the best investors and entrepreneurs backing us, including Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz,
General Catalyst
, Uncommon Projects, Kevin Systrom, Mike Krieger, Lenny Rachitsky, Antoine Martin, Julie Zhuo, Ben Rubin, Jaren Glover, SVAngel, 20VC, Ludlow Ventures, Chapter One, and more.

Please note that all of our roles will require you to be in-person at our NYC HQ (located in Union Square)

About The Role

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager
to help define what the future of AI-native video creation looks like at Mirage. Reporting directly to our CEO and Co-Founder, you’ll operate as a product lead: owning some of our most important product bets while managing and developing a team of Product Managers.

You’ll work closely with our Research, Engineering, Design, and GTM teams to turn rapidly evolving model capabilities into products and workflows that people can rely on every day.

You’ll have significant ownership over both what we build and how we build it
— helping set product direction, staying close to the details, developing the PM team, and raising the bar for product craft and execution across Mirage.

Responsibilities

Define the future of AI video. Develop a strong point of view on how people will create, edit, and communicate with video as agents and underlying models become more capable. Turn that perspective into concrete product bets.
Translate frontier capabilities into products. Work closely with research and engineering to understand what new models can do, where they fail, and how they can become reliable, intuitive experiences for real users.
Build creative systems, not isolated features. Think across the entire creative process. From intent and generation through editing, iteration, and publishing. Create workflows that feel coherent even as the underlying models and modalities change.
Develop exceptional product and model taste. Evaluate generated media across quality, controllability, consistency, latency, cost, and creative usefulness. Help the team distinguish impressive outputs from products our customers rely on.
Stay close to users and the market. Spend time with creators, marketers, businesses, and emerging creative communities. Understand how their workflows are changing and identify behaviors that point toward the next major product opportunity.
Own products end to end. Move from ambiguous problem to prototype, launch, measurement, and iteration. Write clearly, prototype, make tradeoffs, and keep work moving without waiting for perfect information.
Build tight learning loops. Define what success looks like, build eval frameworks, work closely with Data Science, and use real product behavior to improve both the experience and the models behind it.
Shape how products reach the market. Partner with Engineering, Growth, Marketing, and Support on positioning, launches, education, and distribution. The way a new AI capability is explained and introduced is often part of the product itself.
Lead and develop a high-performing Product team. Manage, mentor, and develop Product Managers, setting a high bar for product judgment, execution, and craft

Requirements

5+ years of product management experience, or 8+ years of experience in roles that build exceptional product judgement (founder, early-stage operator, product marketer, growth leader, etc.)
Experience managing and mentoring Product Managers. You’ve directly managed PMs, helped them develop stronger product judgment and execution, and know how to raise the bar while giving people the ownership and support to grow.
Deep fluency in generative media. You actively use and study the latest video, image, audio, and multimodal products. You understand where the space is today, have opinions about where it is heading, and can separate durable shifts from short-lived novelty.
Hands-on experience with AI. You have prototyped or shipped using modern models and tools. You understand their capabilities and failure modes through direct experience—not solely from managing a roadmap around them.
Strong Cross functional leadership. You understand how to influence and work effectively across product, engineering, and executive stakeholders, bringing different perspectives together to drive decisions
Comfort operating in ambiguity. You thrive in fast moving environments, can turn loosely defined problems into clear priorities and create structure.
Strong technical and product communication. You can engage deeply with technical teams, understand technical constraints and tradeoffs, and translate complex ideas into clear product decisions.
A point of view on the future of product management. You’ve thought deeply about how AI has changed the PM function over the last few years and have a perspective on what great product management will look like in the near future.

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
401K with employer match
Commuter Benefits
Catered lunch multiple days per week
Dinner stipend every night if you're working late and want a bite!
Grubhub subscription
Health & Wellness Perks
Multiple team offsites per year with team events every month
Generous PTO policy

Please note benefits apply to full time employees only.

new_jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

Confluent Cloud delivers a complete end-to-end streaming experience via a Software as a Service (SaaS) model. To deliver a simple, understandable, and scalable product experience requires abstracting the complex interactions of underlying cloud infrastructure, networking, storage, and compute powering a stateful distributed system.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Cloud Networking Product team, you’ll contribute to the mission of making connectivity to and from Confluent Cloud reliable, scalable, secure, cost efficient and simple to use so that users can focus on building streaming applications instead of managing infrastructure. Cloud networking with focus on private networking is an enabler for all services offered on Confluent Cloud and is a strategic investment area for Confluent with the potential to impact the company’s top and bottom lines.

You’ll be responsible for the success of major product initiatives, from initial conception to execution and launch. You’ll become the trusted resource for your product, making sure that the engineering, design, sales, and marketing have what they need to make the right tradeoffs, build the right product, and grow it successfully in the market.

What You Will Do

Understand our users: Conduct interviews and analyze data to define personas, user journeys, and key jobs to be done.
Drive crucial aspects of Confluent Cloud Network Roadmap supporting Confluent Cloud services like Kafka, Flink, Connectors, Data Governance, etc with a heavy focus on user experience and cost efficiency.
Define flexible interfaces powering API, CLI and Terraform, data models, and processes and launch a variety of new network options and rapidly iterate on existing ones
Be responsible for the whole lifecycle: Drive multi-team, cross-functional initiatives from conception through initial delivery and ongoing iteration after launch.
Close the loop: Define quantitative and qualitative targets, measure performance against them, share results with stakeholders, and incorporate those learnings into the product.
Manage complexity: Deliver value while handling the surprises and challenges of a quickly evolving product, ambitious partnership targets, and a rapidly growing organization.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with focus on cloud technologies.
Experience building and supporting enterprise-grade products as a product manager, engineer or solutions architect.
Experience building, writing, maintaining and defending a clear product roadmap and backlog backed by user stories and customer research.
Excellent analytical, communication & collaboration skills.
Ability to build relationships with co-workers and customers located around the world.
Demonstrated ability to drive business outcomes through product changes.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

6+ years of experience in Networking in a PM or technical role
Experience with enabling AWS/Azure/GCP private networking features such as Private Link, VPC Peering, Transit Gateway, etc for a SaaS product.
Experience with Envoy, Service Mesh, DNS and Kubernetes Networking.
Experience with network traffic metering and billing.
Domain expertise in networking technologies combined with Product Management experience. An MBA degree is a plus.
